mapper.select: SELECT STORE_CODE AS "storeCode", MAX(STORE_NAME) AS "storeName", BRAND_NAME AS "brandName" FROM ( -- 销售：PRODUCT_CODE = ODS_M_PRODUCT.NAME，只取最近7天（BILL_TIME 为 DATE） SELECT DISTINCT s.STORE_CODE AS STORE_CODE, s.STORE_NAME AS STORE_NAME, p.CARD_NAME AS BRAND_NAME FROM ODS_SALES_MAIN s LEFT JOIN ODS_M_PRODUCT p ON p.NAME = s.PRODUCT_CODE WHERE s.STORE_CODE IS NOT NULL AND p.CARD_NAME IS NOT NULL AND s.BILL_TIME >= SYSDATE - 7 UNION -- 库存：C_STORE_ID → ODS_C_STORE.CODE，M_PRODUCT_ID = ODS_M_PRODUCT.ID，只取最近7天（BILLDATE 为 NUMBER yyyymmdd） SELECT DISTINCT st.CODE AS STORE_CODE, st.NAME AS STORE_NAME, p.CARD_NAME AS BRAND_NAME FROM DWD_STOCK_DAILY d LEFT JOIN ODS_C_STORE st ON st.ID = d.C_STORE_ID LEFT JOIN ODS_M_PRODUCT p ON p.ID = d.M_PRODUCT_ID WHERE st.CODE IS NOT NULL AND p.CARD_NAME IS NOT NULL AND d.BILLDATE >= TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE - 7, 'YYYYMMDD')) ) GROUP BY STORE_CODE, BRAND_NAME
